chars.SALMA: a young Moroccan woman in her twenties with long wavy black hair, wearing a bright red leather jacket over a black top and gold hoop earrings
chars.MOURAD: a Moroccan man in his early thirties with slicked-back black hair and a short trimmed beard, wearing a cream linen suit, white open-collar shirt and a big gold watch
chars.HASSAN: a young Moroccan man in his twenties with short curly black hair, identical twin of Hussein, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.HUSSEIN: a young Moroccan man in his twenties with short curly black hair, identical twin of Hassan, wearing a teal-green hoodie and dark jeans
chars.WORKER: a stocky Moroccan construction worker in his forties with a thick black moustache, wearing dusty grey overalls and an orange hard hat

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan family living room in Casablanca with traditional sedari sofas: SALMA proudly holds MOURAD's arm and smiles, while her twin brothers HASSAN and HUSSEIN stand opposite them with crossed arms, staring at MOURAD with open suspicion. Tense family confrontation.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SALMA and MOURAD laughing at an elegant rooftop restaurant at night in Casablanca, MOURAD casually pulling a thick wad of banknotes from his pocket to pay, luxury and money everywhere.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A big apartment-building construction site in Casablanca at sunset with cranes and concrete pillars; HASSAN and HUSSEIN stand in the middle as supervisors holding a clipboard and blueprints, looking serious, dark clouds gathering in the sky.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On the construction site, the WORKER walks up toward HASSAN and HUSSEIN with a frustrated face, shovel in hand, other workers watching in the background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On the construction site, the WORKER and HASSAN argue face to face, the WORKER throwing his hard hat down angrily, HUSSEIN raising his hand to stop the argument.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Chaos on the construction site: two other workers hold back the furious WORKER who is shouting, while HASSAN and HUSSEIN try to calm him with open hands, dust in the air.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The WORKER points his finger accusingly at HASSAN and HUSSEIN and shouts with a mocking grin, the twins freeze in shock, eyes wide, on the dusty construction site.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a site container office lit by one lamp: HASSAN and HUSSEIN look at each other in confusion and worry; behind them through the window, MOURAD stands in the dark next to a black luxury car, half in shadow, mysterious.
